items.text: Hello burglars,

We recently found a bug that prevented the pumpkin head from spawning properly during the last few hours of our Hackoween event, which meant some of you couldn’t collect enough points to unlock the seasonal cosmetics in time.

We’re really sorry about that and I wanted to inform you that the bug has been identified and fixed in this patch. But to make up for it, we’re extending the Hackoween Special event until November 8th so everyone has a fair chance to grab the cosmetics they were aiming for.
So the pumpkin head is back, Halloween tickets are dropping again, and all the seasonal cosmetics are still unlockable until Sunday night!
Thanks for your patience, and sorry again for the trouble. We hope these extra days help you enjoy the end of the event.
Have fun!

items.text: Hello burglars,

We’re finally coming back with a new major update, bringing you two surprises: Dark Hours: Anomalies, our brand-new co-op horror game mode we revealed last week, and our first monster variants, a new kind of nightmare joining your heists.
Let’s take a closer look at what’s waiting for you!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120298/5842a5e2872fe02a9072f7f6f572eb9d5b720fd4.png"]
The Trickster has a new game for you! Say hello to Dark Hours: Anomalies, a brand-new game mode available now in Dark Hours as part of this major update.

In this new mode, the Trickster has trapped your crew in an endless loop, and your only way out is to spot the supernatural anomalies and make the right call: Clear or Haunted? One wrong answer, and you’re back to the start.
Head to a cursed train station, explore every corner, trust your eyes, and work together with your crew to escape the loop.
1-4 player online co-op: the more eyes, the better
A cursed train station full of shops, offices, restaurants and hidden corridors
Over 40 supernatural anomalies to spot
Clear or Haunted: one wrong answer sends you back to the start
Observation-based gameplay: memorize your surroundings and trust your eyes

One more thing: Dark Hours: Anomalies will also release as a standalone game on Steam next week, on October 29th at $1.99, for anyone who’d like to try just this mode. If you know friends who might be interested, don’t hesitate to tell them about it! Thanks to full crossplay, you’ll all be able to team up together, no matter which version of the game you own.

items.text: Our monsters have been quiet for too long, and some of them are back with a twist. This major update introduces the monster variants: alternate versions of the monsters you already know, with unexpected behaviors to catch you off guard.

And the first to be unleashed are the Golden Stalkers and the Parasitized Ghoul! I won’t spoil anything about their new behaviors so you keep the surprise, but you might get a hint from the teaser below.
And this is only the beginning. More monster variants will come in future updates, so stay tuned.

That’s it for today, burglars. We really hope you’ll enjoy diving into Anomalies and facing our new monster variants. As always, don’t hesitate to share your feedback with us on Discord or the Steam Discussions. We’d love to hear what you think.
Have fun!
Raven

Hey everyone!

A new regular update just dropped for Dark Hours, and this one comes with some changes we think you'll really appreciate, from a big price rebalance to some important fixes to key item spawning that were driving a few of you crazy. Let's get into it!

This is the big one for this update. We've heard your feedback and we've completely rebalanced the prices of all customization items across the game. Van prices are now reduced by 50%, and most other cosmetics have been reduced by approximately 33%. Happy shopping!

We tracked down a sneaky bug that was causing key items (keys, fuses, code papers) to sometimes spawn inside lootsafes at the exact same position as other loot, making them invisible or impossible to collect. If you ever found yourself stuck on a mission with no key in sight... this could have been the cause. It's now fixed!

On top of that, we've added safeguards to make sure key items are always properly available at the start of a mission. If something goes wrong and a key item ends up missing or inaccessible, the game will now automatically respawn it to avoid softlocks.

We've made a number of fixes to monster behavior this update. Several monsters received targeted fixes to address issues with catching players, invisibility, and unexpected spawns. We also fixed a general issue where monsters could get stuck when crossing doors or catching players near them, and resolved several environment objects (like rope barriers, coffee tables, and plants) that were interfering with their navigation.

Voltaic Wraith Spawn Fix: Fixed an issue where the Voltaic Wraith could appear on the floor above players instead of on their actual level.
Electrocution Feedback Fix: Fixed cases where players could remain visually electrocuted indefinitely after certain Voltaic Wraith abilities were interrupted or stacked.
Trickster
Trickster Behavior Fix: Fixed an issue where the Trickster could become stuck when targeting players near certain doorways or inaccessible areas.
PvP
Endscreen Reward Display Fix: Fixed an issue where the endgame screen could show incorrect earnings, displaying $0 at the end of the mission.

PvP Reward Distribution Fix: Fixed an issue affecting how event points were shared between teams in PvP. - Winning Team Reward Fix: Fixed an issue where the winning team could receive an incorrect amount of money at the end of a PvP mission.
Objective Tracking Fix: Fixed an issue where both teams could see the same objective progress, instead of their own respective scores.
Shared Heist/PvP Settings Fix: PvP mode now uses the same settings as Heist, preventing inconsistencies with gameplay parameters.
Outfit Color Reset Fix: Fixed an issue where PvP team colors (red/blue) would persist after returning to the lobby, instead of reverting to players’ custom outfits.
Key Spawn Fix: Fixed an issue where keys would always spawn on the ground instead of appearing in or on furniture.
Mode Switch Menu Fix: Fixed an issue where the monster ban menu could remain open after switching between game modes.
Hidebehind VFX Optimization: Adjusted Hidebehind’s visual effects to improve performance.
Monster Zone Visual Improvement: Improved and optimized the visual effect surrounding monsters for cleaner visuals and better performance.
Main Menu Easter Decorations Fix: Fixed an issue where Easter decorations were not appearing in the main menu.
Soda Dispenser Audio Improvement: Adjusted the soda dispenser sound to be more appropriately muffled.
Heist Items
Adrenaline Bottle Visual Fix: Fixed an issue where the Adrenaline bottle appeared opaque instead of transparent. Also adjusted how the item is held in the player's hand for better visual consistency.
Fire Extinguisher VFX Fix: Fixed an issue where the extinguisher’s smoke effect looked visually incorrect when used.
General
Door and Metal Gate Pass-Through Fix: Fixed an issue where monsters could pass straight through doors or metal gates instead of triggering the proper traversal behaviour.
Monster Targeting Fix: Fixed an issue where monsters could sometimes ignore players if they re-entered the map after going into the van at the end of a mission.
Voltaïc Wraith
Dash Limit Fix: Limited the Voltaïc Wraith to a maximum of two dashes when he sees a player in phase 3.
Explosion Charge Fix: Fixed an issue where the Voltaïc Wraith could charge electricity too quickly before launching his explosion in phase 3.
Mirror Counter Dash Fix: Fixed an issue where the Voltaïc Wraith could continue dashing in phase 3 even after the player used a mirror.
Solo Cooldown Tweak: Increased the Voltaïc Wraith apparition cooldown in Solo mode during phase 3.
Blind Ghoul
Exploration Movement Fix: Fixed an issue where the Blind Ghoul could get stuck while exploring.
Heist Items
Personal Teleporter Safety Update: Added a safety check to prevent activation when there is no valid pad destination, avoiding movement issues and wall-crossing situations.
Mirror Slide Animation Fix: Fixed an issue where starting to throw a mirror and then sliding could keep the throw animation instead of properly switching to the slide animation.
Electrocuted Animation Fix: Fixed an issue where electrocuted animation on players was not looping correctly.
Dropped Item Physics Tweak: Added a small force when dropping items from the inventory to prevent them from falling straight down and getting stuck standing upright.
Safe Interaction Fix: Fixed several issues affecting loot safe interactions, highlight, and feedback.
PVP
Enemy Team Key Pickup Fix: Fixed an issue in PvP where players could pick up the other team’s keys from their team bag or backpacks.
Item Pickup Fix: Fixed several issues where players could pick up items they should not be able to, or could fail to pick up items they should be allowed to retrieve from bags, bins, or else.
PvP Team Color Fix: Fixed an issue where team outfit colors could display incorrectly, causing both teams to appear blue instead of showing distinct team colors.
Objective Selection Fix: Fixed an issue where PvP matches could assign a wrong objective that should not appear in this mode.
Quickplay
Quickplay Crash Fix: Fixed a crash that could occur after using the quickplay search.
Quickplay UI Overlap Fix: Fixed interface overlap issues during quickplay search and joining.
Second Quickplay Search Fix: Fixed an issue where a second quickplay search could appear infinite after leaving a first one.
Voltaic Wraith
VFX Quality Optimisation: Adjusted Voltaic Wraith visual effects to better match quality settings, especially on lower settings.
Voltaïc Wraith Collision Optimisation: Reduced unnecessary detection checks around the Voltaïc Wraith to improve performance.
Electric Arc Optimisation: Optimised the Voltaïc Wraith’s electric arcs to reduce their performance cost.
Voice Chat Performance Optimisation: Improved performance when no microphone is detected and voice chat is still enabled.
Van Computer Interaction Fix: Fixed an issue where the van computer could remain unusable if players returned to the van using teleportation instead of the exit door.
Sink Water VFX Update: Updated visual effects for sink water.
Sink Interaction Fix: Only the faucet is now highlighted during interaction instead of the whole sink.
Broken Glass VFX Update: Updated visual effects for broken glass.
Auction House Crowbar Fix: Fixed an issue in the Accounting Office of the Auction House (seed -1,895,332,854) where the crowbar could appear floating in mid-air.
Breakable Bottle VFX Update: Updated visual effects for breakable bottles.
Key Remapping Confirmation Fix: Fixed an issue where the key remapping confirmation window could appear behind the options menu.
Lobby Gamepad Focus Fix: Fixed gamepad focus issues in the lobby screen.
Mafia Item Unlock Price Feedback Fix: Fixed an issue where some reward unlock prices could appear in white instead of red when the player did not have enough money to unlock them.
Blocked Players List Localisation Fix: Fixed an issue where the text “Block List” wasn't properly localised.
Easter Bunny Beanie Fix: Added the missing Easter customization item "Bunny Beanie".

This update also includes a series of improvements to make your heist sessions smoother, more stable, and comfortable.
Improved texture streaming, including a fix for textures not loading properly on lower-end PCs
Optimized visual effects to reduce their performance impact (e.g. fire extinguisher effects)
Reduced the memory footprint of various in-game assets
Improved VRAM usage, especially beneficial for lower-end graphics cards
Significantly improved performance for hosts during multiplayer sessions
Optimized RAM usage by only loading certain elements when needed
Improved lighting performance for less demanding real-time rendering
Monsters have also received several fixes to improve their behavior and make encounters more intense and consistent:
Better navigation and interaction with doors and the environment
Improved consistency across multiple monster abilities and behaviors (Hidebehind, Banshee, Drifborn, Voltaic Wraith, Trickster)
Adjustments to make certain encounters more fair and less frustrating (Cursed Pharaoh, Stone Stalkers)
Fixes to spawning and positioning issues (Blind Ghoul)
Improved reliability of certain gameplay interactions (Voltaic Wraith, Trickster)
Reduced unnecessary controller vibrations caused by distant monster activity
Alongside these changes, we’ve made a number of bug fixes and general improvements to enhance your overall experience. You can find the full list of changes in the detailed patch notes just below 🔽
Raven
General
Monster Blocking Fix: Fixed an issue where a monster could get stuck because another monster was blocking its way.
Doorway Stuck Fix: Fixed cases where monsters could get stuck or struggle to move properly around doors.
Monster Speed Balancing: Adjusted movement speed for several monsters, especially phase 3 speed tuning.
Post-Teleport Door Movement Fix: Fixed an issue where monsters could move incorrectly after teleporting while in a doorway.
Monster Teleport Vibration Fix: Fixed an issue where monster teleports could repeatedly trigger short gamepad vibrations.
Cursed Pharaoh
Partial Body Appearance Fix:Fixed an issue where the Cursed Pharaoh's body could appear only partially during game startup.
Teleport Height Fix: Fixed an issue where the Cursed Pharaoh could teleport onto the player but appear too low.
Trickster
Trickster Card Hint Update: The Trickster card now gives a hint about where it was picked up.
Dance Result UI Fix: Fixed an issue where the Trickster Dance result could display the wrong outcome when the sequence was interrupted or ended early.
Last Round Arrow Fix: Fixed the last round arrow not working
feedback Fix: Improved feedback in the Trickster Dance minigame.
Chase After Catch Fix: Fixed an issue where the Trickster could keep chasing other players in phase 2 and 3 after catching someone.
Targeting Consistency Fix: Fixed several cases where the Trickster could target the wrong player.
Polaroid Reaction Fix: Fixed an issue where the Trickster would not correctly look at a player using a Polaroid on him.
Solo Inventory Key Fix: Fixed the failed Trickster minigame in Solo mode when pressing the inventory key on keyboard.
Voltaïc Wraith
Mirror Counter Timing Fix: Fixed an issue where using a mirror at the last moment against a Voltaïc Wraith Dash could still result in the player getting hit.
Chase After Catch Fix: Fixed an issue where Voltaïc Wraith could keep chasing other players in phase 3 after catching someone.
Blind Ghoul
Chase Speed Tweak: Adjusted Blind Ghoul chase speed in phase 3, Hard and Nightmare difficulties.
Staircase Navigation Fix: Fixed an issue where the Blind Ghoul could get stuck and stop moving on staircases.
Taser Stuck Fix: Fixed an issue where the Blind Ghoul could get stuck after being hit by the taser gun.
Ragdoll Fix: Fixed an issue affecting the Blind Ghoul’s ragdoll behaviour.
Banshee
Mirror Break Fix: Fixed an issue where mirror could fail to break properly when the Banshee screamed.
Polaroid Counter Fix: Fixed the Polaroid counter interaction with the Banshee.
Chase/Search Audio Fix: Fixed an issue where players could hear Banshee chase/search sounds without seeing her.
Song Duplication Fix: Prevented multiple Banshee songs from playing at once.
Song Sync Fix: Fixed Banshee song synchronization between players.
Stone Stalkers
Chase Speed Tweak: Adjusted Stone Stalkers chase speed in phase 3.
Heist Items
Thrown Truncheon Physics Fix: Fixed truncheon physics when thrown.
Water Gun Reload Persistence Fix: Fixed an issue where the water gun could fail to refill if it was empty when changing level.
Plunger Attachment Fix: Fixed an issue where the plunger could remain stuck in mid-air after being thrown at certain monsters.
Mirror Catch Animation Fix: Fixed an incorrect animation when using the mirror while caught.
Flare Projectile Glass Break Update: Flare projectiles now break glass.
Defibrillator Charger Prompt Fix: Fixed an issue where the defibrillator charger could display the wrong interaction prompt, reusing the prompt from the previously interacted object.
Player Ragdoll Wall Fix: Player ragdolls can no longer pass through walls.
Objective Items Spawn Failsafe: Objective items are now forced to spawn even if no room is left.
Level Transition Input Lock Fix: Inputs are now blocked during the transition screen between the van and the exit to prevent items from being dropped in unreachable areas.
Safe Prompt Refresh Fix: Fixed an issue where safes could display the wrong interaction prompt, reusing the prompt from the previously interacted object.
Padlock Safe Reopen Hit Fix: Hitting an already opened padlock safe no longer reopens it.
Paper Code Text Persistence Fix: Fixed an issue where the paper code number could remain on furnitures when picking it up while already holding another item.
Cruise Ship Door Pickup Fix: Fixed an issue on the Cruise Ship map where items placed on the floor near certain doors could no longer be picked up.
Bathroom Interaction Fix: Fixed interaction issues with certain furnitures in bathrooms that were difficult to interact with.
Washing Machine Outline Fix: Fixed selection outline on the washing machine door.
Cardlock Spawn Fix: Fixed cardlocks spawning inside safes.
Vending Machine Item Collision Fix: Fixed an issue where items could be thrown into the vending coffee machine and hidden inside it.
Vent Exit Opening Fix: It is no longer possible to open a vent from its exit side. Players must now enter from the correct entrance and open the exit from inside.
Tile Weight Activation Fix: Fixed an issue in the Casino vault tile puzzle where the combined weight of multiple objects was not always counted correctly to activate a tile.
Breakable Glass Panel Update: Added breakable glass panels and fixed materials that were only visible from one side.
Lighting Optimisation: Cleaned and optimised lighting in lobby and environments.
Golden Tag Level Lighting Optimisation: Cleaned and optimised lighting in Golden Tag map.
Museum Light Synchronisation Fix: Fixed cases where museum lights could become desynchronised.
Interaction Camera Optimisation: Reduced unnecessary camera-related processing during interactions to improve performance.
Ragdoll Optimisation: Applied several optimisations around ragdolls.
Extinguisher VFX Optimisation: Optimised extinguisher visual effects.
Item Light Shadow Optimisation: Disabled cast shadows on item lights, flare gun, flare, and glowsticks.
Unused Reference Cleanup: Cleaned several references so it is no longer unnecessarily loaded in memory.
Monster Loading Optimisation: Monsters such as the Driftborn and the Hidebehind are no longer loaded by default when not in use.
Overall Assets Optimisation: Several environment assets have been optimised.
Golden Tag
Item Locker Fix: Golden Tag items can no longer be put into the locker.
Item Save Fix: Fixed Golden Tag items being savable.
Relay Connection Fallback: The game now automatically tries different relay configurations on connection failure to improve join reliability.
Duplicate Session Handling Fix: Fixed incorrect handling of duplicate find-session results.
Save Backup Recovery Fix: If no main save is found but a backup exists, the backup is now loaded correctly.
Platform Login Feedback Update: Improved feedback shown on platform login errors.
Kick Message Localisation Fix: Fixed an issue where the kick message could appear in the host’s language instead of the player’s own language.
Voice Occlusion Improvement: Improved voice occlusion so voices are now better blocked by walls and ceilings.
Urinal Flush Sound Fix: Fixed an issue where urinals did not play a sound when flushed.
Gramophone Attenuation Update: Updated gramophone attenuation sound.
Crowbar Hit Sound Volume Fix: Fixed an issue where the sound of being hit by a crowbar could still be heard even when the Sound Effects volume was set to 0.
Gamepad Navigation
Improved gamepad navigation in different menus: Customisation, Score Screen, Locker.
Missing Focus Fix: Fixed several missing focus issues after closing windows.
Color Wheel Gamepad Support: It is now possible to use color wheels with a gamepad.
Color Wheel Input Update: Updated color wheel UI input behaviour.
Player Volume Gamepad Fix: Fixed player volume changes being affected incorrectly by gamepad inputs.
Mafia Items Locked Icon Update: Added a lock icon for Mafia-locked item in the shop.
Mafia Reputation Layout Update: Updated the Mafia reputation layout scaling for better readability.
Contract Selection Settings Menu Fix: Fixed an issue where opening the settings menu during contract selection could break the interface display.
Press to Skip Widget Alignment Fix: Fixed an alignment issue affecting the “Press to Skip” widget.

items.text: Monster Difficulty Balancing: Adjusted monster behaviour and tuning across all difficulty levels to improve overall balance and progression.
HideBehind Rhythm Tweak: Adjusted the rhythm of the HideBehind pattern in phase 3 to make the encounter more readable and better paced.
Monster Detector Walkie-Talkie Fix: Fixed an issue where the Monster Detector walkie-talkie would not work and failed to detect nearby monsters.
Contract Timeout End-of-Night Fix: Fixed an issue where the night would not end correctly if a contract timed out without any vote.

KO Position Display Fix: Fixed an issue where the displayed position of other players when knocked out could remain at the KO spot instead of following the body after being pushed by a monster, such as being knocked from a hallway into a nearby room.
Paper Code Third-Person Position Fix: Fixed the position of the paper code in the character’s hand in third-person view so it appears correctly aligned.
History “Failed” Localisation Fix: Fixed a localisation issue where the “failed” status in the history was not displayed correctly.
Popup Focus Fix: Fixed an issue where some popups did not correctly focus buttons, making them difficult to select.
Contract Focus Fix After First Heist: Fixed an issue where contracts would not receive focus correctly when it was not the first heist in the session.
Lighting adjustement: Fixed the intensity of some lights so lighting feels more natural and consistent.
Van Lighting Fix: Fixed lighting issues affecting vans to restore their original lighting ambiance.
Network Configuration Update: Updated network configuration to improve overall online experience.
Loading Stutter Reduction (PSO Precaching): Enabled PSO precaching to reduce or prevent freezes and stutters during loading.
Monsters
Blind Ghoul Polaroid Hearing Fix: Fixed an issue where the Blind Ghoul could stop reacting to sounds after the player used the polaroid.
Driftborn Chase Ambience Fix: Fixed an issue where Driftborn chase ambient sounds would sometimes not play as intended.
Ragdoll
Player Ragdolls on KO & Death:

Ragdoll Network Sync: In the previous update, we integrated an improvement to the network synchronisation of player ragdolls, forcing body positions to stay in sync between host and client players. We had not announced it yet because we wanted to fine-tune a few things (see below). Further improvements will come later to reduce the small teleports that can still occur when players are revived.
Ragdoll Blending Improvements: Improved ragdoll blending to make transitions into ragdoll states smoother and more natural.
Ragdoll Rotation Fix: Fixed an issue where ragdolls could end up with incorrect or unnatural rotations.
UI & Menus
Game History Loading Optimisation: Reduced the amount of data processed when opening the history menu to slightly improve performance.
Hello everyone,

Today we’re rolling out a new regular update focused on improving the overall gameplay experience, with a particular emphasis on monster behavior, along with a wide range of gameplay, network, UI, and performance fixes based on your feedback.
This patch also includes several optimization improvements. We’d love to hear your feedback and know whether you notice any performance improvements on your end.
You’ll find the full list of fixes and improvements in the detailed patch notes below.
Mummy
Locked Room & Vent Targeting Fix: Fixed multiple cases where the Mummy could become stuck when its targeted player was in a locked room or making noise inside a vent.
Adrenaline Chase Fix: Fixed an issue where the Mummy shot with adrenaline could chase a player endlessly.
Curse Retargeting Fix: Fixed a case where the Mummy could become blocked after cursing one player, killing another one, and then trying to retarget the original cursed player.
Search Movement Fix: Fixed a case where the Mummy could end its movement back at the exact position where it started when searching for a player.
Frozen Mummy Defibrillator Fix: Fixed an issue where players could be caught when using a defibrillator on a Frozen Mummy.
Voltaïc Wraith
Dash Stability Fix: Fixed several issues with Voltaïc Wraith dashes to make behaviour more consistent.
Shield Break Fix: Voltaïc Wraith now correctly destroys shields when dashing, even if the player is moving toward him.
Mirror Break Fix: Fixed a bug where mirrors were not broken by the Voltaïc Wraith dash if the player moved forward.
Electric Bomb VFX Adjustments: Tweaked and fixed the visual effects for the electric bomb to make them clearer and more consistent.
Electric Arc Dance Fix: Fixed a bug where a player’s dance animation wasn't stop when hit by an electric arc.
Trickster
Forced Dance Interrupt Fix: Fixed an issue where the forced dance in front of the Trickster could be cancelled by another monster’s attack.
Umbrella Target Switch Fix: Fixed a bug where the Trickster could appear as just a moving umbrella after losing the player he was chasing and instantly switching to another one.
Box Item Collision Fix: Items now correctly collide with the Trickster’s boxes, preventing players from throwing random items inside them.
Mirror Interaction Fix: Fixed a bug where mirrors did not work with the Trickster.
Mirror Reaction Trigger Fix: Fixed a bug where the Trickster could react as if a mirror was used even when the player was not using one.
Water Counter Fix: Fixed an issue where water would not counter the Trickster correctly the second time it was used against him in a short period of time.
Chtulian Monster
Camouflage Behaviour Fix: Fixed an issue where the Chtulian Monster camouflage effect could move and disappear constantly instead of behaving as intended.
Lobby Items & Locker
Item Transfer Fix: Fixed an issue where items held by players when reloading a lobby and then leaving without changing inventory were not automatically transferred into the locker.

Full Locker Overflow Fix: When leaving the lobby with items that could go into the locker while the locker is already at maximum capacity, those items are now correctly lost instead of pushing the locker past its intended limit.
Lobby Reload Transfer Fix: Fixed a case where reloading a lobby and then leaving without gaining or losing items could prevent the player’s items from being transferred into the locker.
Mafia

Unlock With Full Locker Fix: Fixed an issue where Mafia customization rewards could not be unlocked when the locker was full; the locker limit now behaves as intended and only prevents overflow where appropriate.
Price Consistency Fix: Mafia reward unlock prices are now consistent across all relevant screens.
Rewards & Free Purchase Fix: Fixed issues where Mafia rewards could be purchased for free or at incorrect level requirements.
Bosses Purchase Fix: Fixed an issue where players could not buy items from Mafia Bosses.
Heist Items
Personal Teleporter
Knockout Flip Fix: Fixed an issue where the teleporter pad could sometimes flip to the wrong side after the player had been knocked out.
Drop Bump Fix: Fixed a minor issue causing a small “bump” when the teleporter pad was dropped below the player.
Flash Camera
Light & Range Coherence Update: Adjusted Flash Camera light and range values to be more coherent.
Wall Flash Fix: Flash Camera flashes no longer pass through walls.
Counter Range Fix: Fixed Flash Camera counter range behaviour.
Range Scaling Fix: camera range now scales properly depending on the type of Camera used.
GPS Walkie-Talkie
GPS Paper Codes Persistence Fix: Fixed paper codes that could remain displayed on the GPS even after being collected.
Double Door GPS Position Fix: Fixed the GPS position of some double doors that could be slightly offset from their actual location.
Security Gate Button Fix: Fixed a security gate linked to a button that would sometimes only activate every other press.
Director’s Office Door State Fix: Fixed the director’s office door staying open if the player approached before the opening animation was fully finished.
Vault Pedestal Interaction Fix: Fixed the pedestal in the vault so that players can no longer place another item on it while the original objective item is still present.
Van Collision Fix: Fixed collision on the rear of the van in the lobby to prevent players from getting snagged or blocked.
Gamepad Navigation Update: Improved gamepad navigation in menus.
Social & Moderation
Player Moderation System: Added an in-game ban / block system so players can block unwanted players; blocked players are muted, hidden behind obfuscated names, and added to a Block List.
Block List System: Added a cross-platform Block List system.
Scoreboard Social Buttons: Added social buttons to the scoreboard, allowing quick access to social actions on other players.
Scoreboard Refresh After Kick: Updated the scoreboard so it now refreshes after kicking a player.
Player Platform Icons: Added platform icons per player and initialised them properly in the pause menu.
Player Lobby Slot Update: Updated player lobby slots visuals to better reflect player status in the lobby.
Locker Interface
Menu Behaviour: The locker menu now closes when pressing the Tab key and provides clearer feedback when the maximum item limit is reached, along with a visual update.
Locker Slot Count Fix: Fixed the displayed number of slots in the player locker screen so it correctly matches the actual number of available slots.
Golden Tag
HUD Separator Fix: Fixed a UI issue where a “:” character could remain visible on the HUD in Golden Tag mode when no score limit was set.
Input Icon Update: Updated input icons across the UI to improve clarity and consistency.
Menu Focus Fixes: Fixed several focus issues in menus.
Modal Z-Order Fix: Fixed modal windows so they are now correctly displayed above other UI elements.
Relay Connection Fallback: The game now automatically tries different relay configurations on join failure to improve connection reliability.
Block List Cloud Save: The new Block List system is backed by cloud save so your moderation settings follow you across sessions.
Server Frame Time Optimisation: Improved server performance, reducing frame time when playing with other players.
Lights Optimisation: Optimised lights in the game and lobby to reduce their impact on performance.
Vault Tiles Optimisation: Optimised vault tiles in Casino and Power-Plant levels for better performance.
Vault Room Gate Sound Fix: Fixed a case where the sound of the vault room gate could continue indefinitely when rapidly raising and lowering the gate.
Moonlight Fireworks Ignition Fix
Fixed an issue where Moonlight fireworks would sometimes not fire, especially if they were dropped after being ignited.
Fixed performance issues of fireworks when hitting a player.
Voltaïc Wraith

Spectator Camera Fix: Fixed an issue where being killed by the Voltaïc Wraith’s laser attack while out of revives could lock the spectator camera, preventing players from rotating the camera around the character they were watching.
Dash Stability Fix: Improved the Voltaïc Wraith’s dash behaviour to clean up edge cases and add safeguards, reducing the chances of unexpected behaviour during its dash.
Crossplay Join Crash Fix: Fixed a crash that could occur when joining a game in crossplay.
Player Money Color Update: Updated the Moonlight Tickets text color to improve readability.
Display Case Glass Break Sound Fix: Fixed a muffled glass break sound on certain display cases so the impact feels clearer and more responsive.
Glass and Mirror Material Updates: Updated several glass and mirror materials to improve reflections and overall visual quality.
Flashlight Specular Reduction: Reduced specular reflections from the flashlight to make lighting more comfortable and readable.
Door Lock Indicator Material Update: Updated the door lock indicator material to make the locked/unlocked state clearer at a glance.
Moonlight Letter Ownership Fix: Fixed a specific case where the owner of a Moonlight letter was incorrectly reset.
Moonlight Gift Mid-air Pickup Fix: Fixed an issue where picking up a Moonlight gift in mid-air would incorrectly award points to the player who threw it.
Seasonal Decorations Replication Fix: Fixed replication issues with Moonlight decorations so that all players now see the same decorative elements in the environment.
Golden Tag
Score Condition Fix: Fixed an issue where players needed 51 points to win when the target was 50; reaching the required score now correctly counts as a win.
Hello burglars,

I’m back today to announce that we’re rolling out a new regular update! In this update, you’ll find a brand-new seasonal event, Moonlight, bringing a new seasonal gameplay, festive decorations, exclusive cosmetics, and multiple bug fixes!

Easy Mode Phase Fix: Fixed an issue where the Voltaïc Wraith could remain stuck in phase 1 on easy difficulty.
Banshee

Infinite Scream Fix: Fixed an issue where the Banshee’s scream could loop infinitely.

Hello everyone,

Today we’re rolling out a new regular update! Now that we’re back from the holiday break, the team has been fully focused on improving the overall gameplay experience, with an emphasis on monster navigation, level design improvements, and a wide range of gameplay, interface, and stability fixes based on your feedback.
You’ll find all the fixes and improvements in the detailed patchnote below.

⚠️ Known Issues: We are aware of ongoing lobby connection issues affecting some players, particularly in certain regions of the world (including Russia), as well as performance issues that may cause lag for some players.
We’ve also identified monster navigation issues on the Cruise Ship map, which can cause monsters to get stuck in front of doors (mainly observed with the Banshee, but not exclusively).

Our team is actively investigating these problems and working on improvements. Fixes will be deployed as soon as they are ready in an upcoming patch. Thank you for your patience and for your continued feedback.
Freezing & Electrocution Duration Fix: Fixed an issue where freezing and electrocution durations were not correctly adjusted by difficulty.
Invisible Monster Room Fix: Fixed an issue where a monster could get stuck inside a locked room while in an immaterial or invisible state.

Improved Navigation for Banshee and Voltaic Wraith: Improved the navigation of Banshee and Voltaic Wraith in the maps. More work in progress about that point for all monsters and maps in an upcoming update.
Door Closing Fix: Fixed an issue where it was impossible to close a door when an invisible monster was standing in it.
Electrocution Fix: Fixed an issue where the Driftborn was not properly affected by electrocution.

Locker Input Context Fix: Fixed an issue where being caught by the Trickster while hiding in a locker could leave the player incorrectly flagged in that state, causing controller inputs to open the inventory instead of controlling the Trickster's minigame.
Revive Overlay Sleep Interaction Fix: Fixed an issue where being put to sleep during the Trickster minigame and die, could cause the revive countdown to instantly drop to zero seconds.
Locked Room Spawn Fix: Fixed an issue where the Voltaïc Wraith could become stuck in a locked room and repeatedly respawn.
Key Item Spawner Tweaks: Added more spawners in certain areas to prevent key items from spawning on the ground and being missed by players.
Grid Lift Invincibility Fix: Fixed a bug where a client player lifting a grid could become invincible to grids falling on them.
Coffee Machine Interaction Tweak: Made the coffee machine interaction easier to catch, improving usability.
Washing Machine Camera Shake Fix: Fixed an issue where the washing machine would repeatedly apply camera shake to the same player; it now only does so once when used as intended.
Door Red Light Indicator Update: Updated the intensity of the red light indicator when a door is closed to improve readability.
Cruise Ship Vault Laser Trigger Fix: Fixed an issue where vault lasers on the Cruise Ship could start triggering on their own after one of them had been activated.
General Improvements: Reworked loot safe padlocks to improve interactions and clarity when unlocking them.
Highlight & Interaction Update: Updated safe padlocks so they are now properly highlightable and easier to identify when they can be interacted with.
Replication Fix: Fixed replication issues affecting padlock state between host and clients.
Minimap Vent Visibility Fix: Fixed an issue where players inside vents on upper floors would not appear on the minimap.
Minimap Exclamation Icons Fix: Fixed an issue where exclamation mark icons on the minimap did not keep a consistent rotation like the text.

Defibrillation Crash Fix: Fixed a crash that could occur when a player with earmuffs in their inventory was ejected with a defibrillator, dropped the item in hand, auto-equipped the earmuffs, and later stored them in their locker in the van.: Minimap Vent Visibility Fix: Fixed an issue where players inside vents on upper floors would not appear on the minimap.: KO Exit Fix: Fixed a bug where teleporting between the van and the level on exit while being knocked out could cause the player to respawn on a lower floor than intended.: Mirror Slide Passenger Fix: Fixed an issue where the passenger of a mirror slide could end up below the floor or bouncing above or below the expected position after the slide.: Thrown Items Re-Interaction Fix: Fixed a bug where thrown items would no longer interact with an object they had already interacted with after being picked up again.: Paper Code Side Menu Input Fix: Fixed an issue where a player who closed the paper code minigame with Escape, then opened the side menu while another player finished the minigame, could still have gameplay inputs active in the side menu making difficult to exit it.: Lobby Trashbag Loot Fix: Fixed an issue where trashbags in the lobby level weren't tagged as lobby items.

Minigame Mute/Unmute Fix: Fixed an issue where players could not mute or unmute audio during minigames.
Defibrillator Station Biker Van Fix: Fixed an issue where the defibrillator station was missing from the Biker van; it is now present as intended.
Grenade Decal Fade-Out Fix: Fixed an issue where grenade impact decals did not fade out correctly, improving feedback and visual clarity.
Arrow Minigame UI Fix: Fixed a case where asterisks could be shown instead of arrows under specific conditions in the safe minigame when playing solo.

Monster Names in History: Fixed an issue where monster names were not correctly loaded in the game history.

Hello everyone,

Today we’re rolling out a new regular update! Over the past few days, the team has been fully focused on improving the overall gameplay experience, especially when it comes to monster behavior and several connectivity issues you've reported.
You’ll find all fixes and improvements in the detailed patchnote below.
We’re not done yet! Some issues are still being actively investigated, including:

Microphones: With version 1.0, we transitioned from the Steam SDK to the EOS SDK for microphone and audio management. This now allows players to configure audio settings directly in the game — something that wasn’t possible before. However, we’re still working with EOS support on a few reported cases where players lose microphone functionality between the lobby and missions, or directly within the lobby. We’ll continue tracking these issues and will release a fix as soon as possible.

Online Connectivity: This patch includes improvements to multiplayer connectivity. We’ve resolved some issues related to Steam Friends invites and identified the causes of ghost lobbies that previously prevented players from rejoining their friends. Some connection issues are occasionally caused by temporary interruptions in EOS services, which are beyond our control. Others might be related to firewall configurations, which we’re currently investigating. We’ll keep working to improve stability — if you’re still experiencing connection problems, please contact us so we can better understand and address the root cause.

Crashes: With the addition of new features and content, a few players have reported crashes. Some appear to be GPU-related and are still under investigation. Most of the other crashes have been resolved, but we’re aware of a rare issue that can occur during “Sabotage” missions. If you experience a crash, please share your crash dump files with us to help the development team complete their debugging and improve stability.
We’ll keep pushing updates as we make progress on these bugs.
Thank you again for your incredible support, it truly helps us improve the game, fix bugs, and deliver the best experience possible.

Hello everyone,

It’s been just a week since Dark Hours 1.0 launched, and what a week it’s been! I’ll probably come back to that in more detail in a special dev log coming soon, to give you a clearer picture of everything that’s been going on behind the scenes.

In the meantime, thank you so much for all your feedback, reports, and support since launch. We’ve been working hard over the past week to fix the most urgent issues, and and today here we are, bringing you our first regular update since 1.0.
This one focuses on improving your experience by addressing several of the biggest issues you’ve been reporting, community requests, and a bit of balancing.

notes.title: 🎙️ Mic fixes, lobby connections and more

items.text: As many of you probably noticed, our major issue at launch was related to voice chat, lobbies, and game crashes. We’re really sorry that you had to deal with these problems during your games.

Over the past few days, we’ve been in constant contact with Epic Games support to track down the root of the problem, and we finally found a proper technical solution yesterday! (more details about that will be shared in the upcoming dev log.)
The most important thing: these major issues should now be fixed with this patch.

Note: For the microphone, we recommend checking your settings to make sure the detection threshold is properly adjusted. We usually keep it set between 90% and 100% internally, but you may need to tweak it depending on your setup. The default value will be reajusted on a future patch.
As some of our early access players know, items purchased in the shop and used during a mission couldn’t be recovered afterward — they simply disappeared once the heist was over.

For version 1.0, the gameloop was reworked with the new heist night and contract selection, and we announced that items could be reused from mission to mission. Well… for reasons (related to the point just above), that wasn’t actually the case until now. Oops. But that’s fixed!

From now on, any items you buy in the shop, use during a heist, and still have in your backpack at the end of the mission will stay with you when you return to the lobby. You’ll be able to sell them, transfer them to your locker, keep them for your next job, or even give them to your teammates.
⚠️ Note: items that are already available in the lobby or the van, (as well as those looted during a heist), cannot be resold.
This is something we really wanted to have ready for release, but the launch schedule was... intense. 😅
So, surprise! Vans now feature custom interiors when you start a heist.
Here are a few screenshots so you can check out their new looks! Which one is your favorite?

Another good news, we heard you. We’ve rebalanced item prices across the board. You’ll find the full list of changes in the patch notes below. Tell us which items you’re enjoying most!
You can also move items back to your locker and sell them, and for a limited time, you can sell them for 100% of their purchase price. Don’t miss out!

We’ve also fixed a bunch of other bugs, you can find the complete patchnote below for a more detailed overview. Please let us know if you still run into any issues, we’re keeping an eye on it and will continue to monitor reports closely.

We can’t thank you enough for your patience, understanding, and all the feedback you’ve shared since launch. We know there are still bugs and improvements to tackle, and we’re doing our best to address them as quickly as possible.
Have a great day!
Raven

notes.title: The "All Bets Down!" Major Update for Dark Hours is LIVE NOW!

items.text: This update introduces plenty of new content, including features planned in the roadmap—such as a new monster, a new environment and a difficulty settings. We’ve also added some unexpected surprises, like a completely reworked lobby!
Complete patchnote available at the bottom of this news!

notes.title: 🃏Give a huge round of applause for the star of the show: The Trickster Demon!

items.text: This little prankster loves to hide things that don’t belong to him—stay on your toes!

notes.title: 🎰Come bet your future in The Casino!

items.text: Come explore a brand-new environment to rob in this casino, lit up by a thousand lights!

notes.title: 💪Customize the difficulty settings like you want

items.text: Is your game too easy? Too hard? You can now adjust the game presets to change the difficulty like you want!
Feel free to give us feedback, we will make adjustments based on your input over the next few days.
Enjoy a brand-new 3D lobby to prepare yourself for your next heist!

notes.title: 🔫Brand new playable items are now available!

items.text: The extinguisher was already a really cool and versatile item, come check out these new ones:
A Taser: If someone gives you trouble, defend yourself with this magnificent Taser
A water balloon: They say water and electricity don’t mix well. I’ll let you test that out.
A water gun: After the Dart Gun, who’s adding this? What could possibly be the point of it?
Come play new co-op minigames to progress in your heists and reach your goal while making sure to survive your pursuers!

Many bugs have been fixed, and various improvements have been made based on your feedback from the past few weeks. You can find the full details of these bug fixes and improvements at the end of this news post!

Have fun!

Hello burglars,
A brand-new regular update is here for Dark Hours! It brings new seasonal customizations, emotes, dance, and more. Here’s a look at the latest additions and improvements.

Celebrate Valentine’s Day and Lunar New Year with exclusive, limited-time items! Deck out your character with stylish glasses, backpacks, and headwear to become the most fashionable burglar around. Let's complete some contracts to earn enough cash and grab these trending items!
These festive customizations will only be available until February 25, so don’t miss your chance to grab them before they’re gone.
Reminder: As previously mentioned, the Christmas customizations are no longer available. Keep an eye out for future seasonal items!
Bring some playful competition to your heists! The classic Rock-Paper-Scissors emote is now available. Ready to bet your share of the loot on a quick match?
Who says burglars can’t keep up with the trends? Show off your moves with the Kemusan dance, perfect for adding some flair to your next heist.
A new cinematic intro for Museum missions.
You can now ban multiple monsters in game settings.
Hide the HUD for cleaner screenshots – time to capture your best moments!
Hosts can now kick or ban players in both public and private lobbies.
General fixes and improvements (monster improvements, customization now accessible from the main menu, room names are now correctly displayed on all doors, and more...)
Check out the full patch notes below for more details!

items.text: Hello everyone,
We're excited to announce that The Cursed Pharaoh Update for Dark Hours is now available for everyone!
This major update brings plenty of new content, including planned features, highly requested features from the community, and a few surprises!

notes.title: 🔪 An ancient slasher comes to hunt you: The Mummy

items.text: Get ready to be chased by a brand-new creature: the Mummy. This terrifying monster loves watching you and slowly closing in to impale you with its blade!

notes.title: 🏛 Want to pull off a heist in a Museum, right? Let's go!

items.text: What better place than a Museum to line your pockets? A brand-new heist environment, The Museum, is now available to explore. Enjoy a set of 16 different layouts to make each of your heists unique! Time to plan your next big score!

notes.title: 👋Say hello to the newest member of the team

items.text: The boss wanted to strengthen our crew. So he brought in this new recruit. Consider them one of us! You now have the choice between two types of burglars!
Assemble a team of professional burglars faster than the speed of light! By popular demand, we’ve added a quick matchmaking system to make it easier to form groups.
Note: The servers will be active starting tomorrow.
Wanted to switch up your backpack? This update is for you! You can now customize your backpacks!
While we already had a hairdryer and a foghorn, what else could we possibly add to the game? Well, it’s simple:
Coffee: Grab a cup, place it in the coffee machine, and enjoy a nice hot brew!
Extinguisher: What could you possibly do with this during a heist? I’ll let you figure that out!
Defibrillator: You can now revive a teammate who died too soon. Just be careful—it’s charged with electricity, so don’t shock someone who’s still alive!
You wanted a way to communicate in the game without micro, and now it’s here! Check out our brand-new tag feature and fresh emotes.

But what's the "Golden Tag"? We wanted to introduce a lighter, more fun game mode to play between heists! Your goal is to keep the title for as long as possible! Your opponents can take it from you by pushing you. Anything goes.

We’ve improved the keybinding interface to make it smoother and more user-friendly! To prevent you from getting completely stuck when choosing contracts, we’ve also added a countdown! Other minor improvements have also been made based on your feedback!
This update will be the last major one for 2024, but it’s definitely not the last we have planned for Dark Hours!. Starting in 2025. more updates are planned so get ready for more features to come!
As always, we can’t wait to hear your feedback. Feel free to share it on the Steam forums, on Discord, or directly via email.
We hope you enjoy this update as much as we enjoyed designing and developing it! We can't wait to hear all about how your heists went!
Dark Hours Steam page 🔽
Have fun!
Raven

All these changes aim to improve the overall gameplay experience. You can find the complete patchnote just below.

We’re deeply grateful for all the feedback and suggestions you’ve shared with us since the launch. The team is actively working on the next big update planned for the holiday season, and we’re excited to tease the arrival of a brand-new map environment (yes, we heard you 😉) with dozens of layouts, along with new contract objectives, a new monster and even more surprises.
Thank you for being part of this incredible journey with us! Let us know what you think of The Kisser and good luck on your heists!

items.text: Hello everyone,
We’re thrilled to announce that a brand-new update is now available for our demo, packed with bug fixes, improvements, and exciting new features!
Your feedback has been invaluable, and we’ve been working hard to improve the demo over the past two weeks.
Here are some of the major improvements and features included in this update:
General improvements on the Hidebehind AI
You can now kill your friends with the crowbar (be the first to strike)
Addition of Safes
New animations for robbers
Lighting improvement
Break the display windows with the crowbar to steal items
You can read the complete patchnote just below.
Push Interactions: Fixed an issue where players could get caught while lifting gates. The action will now be canceled correctly.
Item Swap: Players can now swap items between the quick inventory and backpack even if both are full.
Mini-Game Fixes: Ensured mini-game success is correctly handled and prevented double endings for mini-games.
Revive Interaction: Fixed issues when interacting with downed players for revival.
Spectator mode: Improvement on spectator mode
Control Room Door: The control room door no longer shows an interaction prompt until unlocked.
Gate Interaction: Fixed an issue where lifting a grille would not correctly reset its position if interrupted.
New: “Push” animation when the player is crouching or crawling
New: “Knock knock” animation when the player is crouching or crawling
New: Add Safes.
Behavior Enhancements: Various improvements to the monster's behavior and animations.
Capture Timing: Fixed issues with the monster's capture timing and interaction with lights.
Speed Increase: The monster now accelerates after two seconds of pursuit but loses target memory faster to encourage evasive maneuvers.
Action Delay: Reduced the maximum delay between two actions of the monster from 0.5 seconds to 0 seconds.
ADD: Monster doorway passage animation
VFX: Updated VFX for small lights
UI Enhancements: Add new layouts for “dying” and “reviving” overlays
Objective Feedback: Added new objective feedback for better clarity.
Error Messaging: Added error messages when kicked from a room.
End Game Menu: Fixed appearance and navigation issues in the end game menu.
Lobby Rework: Updated lobby with map selection, equipment preview, and an invite code hide/show feature.
Invite code: Fixed invite code font
Inventory Toggle: Fixed the issue where items wouldn't toggle properly in the inventory.
Stamina: Stamina bar affected by carried weight.
Lighting: Ambiance improvement
Localization: Added French localization for the game.
Breakable Glass: Players can now break display case glass.
Inventory Management: Improved inventory updates for actions like swapping items between quick inventory and backpack.
Gamepad Navigation: The game is now fully navigable and playable with a gamepad without losing focus.
Motion sickness: New options: Camera shakes and activate a reticle.
Invite code streamers: By default, the code is hidden.
See ya!
